name: protected-paths
summary: Blocks write/edit/bash writes to protected paths: secrets and agent-control surfaces under the coding firewall policy, git's hooks/, config and info/ under both policies, plus .git/, node_modules/ and agent definitions under the pentest policy (PI_KIT_PROTECTED_PATHS adds entries). Optional allowlist mode (PI_KIT_WRITE_ALLOWLIST) blocks writes to anything NOT allowlisted — the enforcement point for dream/print-mode runs.
